pickup.body_md:
## What

`drain-cycle grade` reads all grade files with `status: confirmed`, reports the pass-rate across the window, and exits nonzero if any entry has `final_linear_state == "completed"` AND `outcome_verdict == null` (a silent-Done violation). All drains are graded — there is no flow filter.

## Why

This is the grading command the operator runs to assess initiative health. Without it, KR grading is manual and the silent-Done brake has no mechanical teeth.

## Assumptions

* Grade files with `status: draft` are excluded from the report but warned about.
* The pass-rate denominator is the count of confirmed entries in the measurement window.

## Key Risks

* If the run-log entry and the grade file are out of sync (e.g. run-log updated after confirmation), the command may produce a misleading result.
* The silent-Done detection must be exact: a Done entry with `outcome_verdict` `== ``null` is the violation; nothing else is.

## Definition of Done

* `drain-cycle grade` reports: total tickets graded, pass-rate, any silent-Done violations by issue ID.
* Any silent-Done violation causes exit code ≠ 0.
* Un-confirmed drafts are reported as warnings, not counted in the rate.
* A run with no violations exits 0.
